mechanism: Ciprofloxacin may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of captopril through inhibition of renal prostaglandin synthesis and potential effects on the renin-angiotensin system; both drugs also increase renal impairment risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure control and renal function (creatinine, potassium) during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antibiotic if captopril efficacy is compromised.
